results.title: Amazon's next big logistics bet rips a page from its AWS playbook and rattles rivals
Supply Chain Stocks Are Plunging on Amazon's Logistics Launch
OpenAI's subtle drift from Microsoft has become an aggressive move toward Amazon
Top 12 Amazon Competitors and How to Beat Them (2026)

summary: Amazon launched Supply Chain Services (logistics-as-a-service), hammering UPS (-9%) and FedEx (-8%) on May 4. In cloud: Microsoft Azure remains primary AWS competitor. OpenAI is shifting partnerships from Microsoft toward Amazon AWS, boosting AWS AI backlog. Walmart ($713.2B revenue) closes gap in e-commerce/delivery. BYD EV sales declining for 8th month - less relevant to AMZN directly.
